method.sea: water occurrence >= 0.5 of the months, polygons at 20 m touching the AOI edge, >= 100 ha
method.baseline: sea mask opened by 50 m, boundary minus the AOI cut (60 m), Douglas-Peucker 40 m, smoothed over +-250 m, lines >= 500 m
method.transects: every 100 m, perpendicular over +-100 m, 300 m landward to 500 m seaward, samples every 10 m
method.position: landward edge of the sea-connected water: walk from the seaward end until 3 land samples in a row; none if < 80% agreement, no sea at the seaward end, or water to the landward end
method.rate: from quarterly shorelines (water in >= half of a quarter's radar looks, tide-averaged): linear regression rate (m/yr, seaward +) with a 95 % CI, >= 5 quarters; advancing / retreating only when the CI excludes 0
method.nsm: net shoreline movement: mean of the last 2 quarterly positions minus mean of the first 2
method.tidal: monthly positions with an IQR > 100 m: a wide intertidal flat; monthly lines there move with the tide
method.confirmation: change = radar trend confirmed by the Sentinel-2 dry-season shoreline (median MNDWI > 0) moving the same way by >= 20 m between the first and last dry season; otherwise unconfirmed
method.tide: monthly positions include tide differences (several m range, D11); the 24-month rate is the reported quantity
